description: The signed-in couple's own booked vendors on Zola: record that the couple booked 1 vendor of the Zola catalog, in her list of booked vendors. It does not contact the vendor to make a booking, and it pays nothing. Name the vendor by vendor_slug, the slug of zola_search_vendors or zola_get_vendor_details, or by vendor_id, the id of zola_list_my_booked_vendors: exactly 1 of the 2. If the couple has a conversation with the vendor on Zola, Zola marks it booked and the vendor sees a message. A booking can give the couple a promo code. The preview names a vendor booked for the same type already. Zola adds the price to the budget. If the budget has another cost for this vendor type, the couple chooses the cost on the booked vendors page of zola.com. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview with a confirm_token. Show the preview to the couple. Call again with the same arguments and the confirm_token only after the couple says yes. Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same arguments

vendor_id.description: The vendor_id of a booked vendor from zola_list_my_booked_vendors. Give vendor_slug or vendor_id, not both

vendor_slug.description: The slug of the vendor from zola_search_vendors or zola_get_vendor_details. Give vendor_slug or vendor_id, not both
